## Environment

Node version, remark and remark-cli versions, plugin version, operating system, and terminal:

## Reproduction

Include a minimal Markdown input, configuration, and command. Remove private paths and credentials.

## Expected and actual behavior

Include relevant output and whether host-level skipping, `--output` rewriting, stdin, or a custom syntax was used.
